assertions.assertion: Subclasses DefaultScopeParser (or implements IScopeParser) and overrides ParseScopeValue(ParseScopeContext)
Uses scopeContext.SetParsedValues(name, parameter) for the parameterized scope and SetError/SetIgnore for other cases
assertions.rationale: Uses scopeContext.SetParsedValues(name, parts[1]), SetError and SetIgnore.

assertions.assertion: Registers the parser via AddScopeParser<T>() on the IdentityServer builder
In IProfileService reads context.RequestedResources.ParsedScopes.FirstOrDefault(x => x.ParsedName == "transaction") and uses its ParsedParameter
Does NOT define the parameterized value as a static ApiScope name
assertions.rationale: Only base ApiScope("transaction") is registered; parameter value is not a static scope.
